name: piter-jaluzi
description: Piter-Jaluzi monorepo: Astro storefront, Express API, Telegram admin, Docker Compose for Yandex Cloud

scripts.dev: npm run dev:back & npm run dev:front; wait
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix front ci && npm --prefix back ci
scripts.check: npm --prefix front run check && npm --prefix back run check
scripts.test: npm --prefix back run check && npm --prefix back run test:smoke
